content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble with my SD card for [product_name]. It's a 32GB card, formatted slowly with FAT32. The SD card works with an older [product_name] [article_no], but not in my new [article_no]. Should I try a different formatting method, or could the new [product_name] be faulty? [user_name]
I don't think that's the issue. What does the diagnostic tool on the [product_name] report?
When I attempt to transfer data from [product_name] to the card, it switches between the messages "No space in card" and "Card unknown."
It seems like the SD card might be the problem. Do you have another card you can use for testing?
I've tested the SD card with an older [product_name] [article_no], and it works fine there.

I noticed in your initial message that the SD card works with another [product_name]. However, I still suspect the SD card might be causing the problem. Did you check what the diagnostics function on the [product_name] shows? Go to System menu > Diagnostics > Hardware > SD card.
During diagnostics, the error message displayed is: "Micro SD Card Card detached." [user_name]

It's difficult to diagnose from a distance. In my experience, I have several [product_name] units, each with an SD card. I've used different SD cards of various brands, capacities (32GB, 64GB), and classes, but have never encountered any issues. My advice is to submit a support request.

Hi, I agree with the previous comments. If the [product_name] can't detect the SD card, it won't function. Even if the SD card works in another [product_name], that's not relevant. If you still have doubts, you could try replacing the [product_name], but make sure the SD card is detected by the replacement unit; otherwise, you may encounter the same problems.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are facing SD card compatibility problems with a newer [product_name], although the card operates correctly in an older version. Error messages such as 'No space in card', 'Card unknown', and 'Card detached' are shown during troubleshooting, resulting in uncertainty about whether the issue is with the SD card or the [product_name]. The users are looking for clear, consistent handling of SD cards across different versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect SD cards to work reliably between various [product_name] models and versions, with dependable detection and clear diagnostic feedback to simplify troubleshooting.
